@Bettina, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest for 2 November says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your belated cutover recap (8 Dec 2025) confirms the official handoff was November 3.

For the tracker, note that you kept running PHL day to day until 21 November, and your recap says Kwame fully took over on **22 November 2025**. If the tracker wants the day-to-day date rather than the official one, use the 22nd.
